channel.title: The Grant Desk - added in last 30 days, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: added in last 30 days, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily. Each drop carries at most 10 grants, closest deadlines first; the rest follow the next Sunday.

item.title: Coding it Forward: Winter Fellowship 2027 (US civic tech placements)
item.description: Coding it Forward · deadline 25 Oct 2026 · Paid full-time job placement: USD 20 per hour for applicants with a Bachelor's degree, USD 25 per hour for applicants pursuing or holding a graduate degree (Master's or PhD), at 40 hours per week for ten weeks (roughly USD 8,000 to 10,000 in total). Pay rates and work dates are non-negotiable. No application fee.

item.title: Anthropic STEM Fellows Program 2027 (four-month AI-for-science fellowship, January to May 2027)
item.description: Anthropic · deadline 28 Oct 2026 · USD 100,000 to 167,000 for the four-month fellowship (equivalent to USD 300,000 to 500,000 annualised), plus benefits; fellows are engaged through an employer of record on a fixed-term contract. No application fee.

item.title: Ernest Albert Invitational 2027: Artistic Development Residency at Cas-co x Kunsthal Mechelen
item.description: Cas-co, Leuven and Kunsthal Mechelen · deadline 28 Oct 2026 · EUR 6,080 total including VAT: an artist fee of EUR 1,100 per month, a transportation allowance of EUR 120 per month, and a one-time production budget of EUR 1,200. Kunsthal Mechelen provides additional artist and production fees for the exhibition. No application fee.

item.title: Paul & Daisy Soros Fellowships for New Americans 2027 (US graduate study)
item.description: The Paul & Daisy Soros Fellowships for New Americans · deadline 29 Oct 2026 · Up to USD 90,000 over two years (stipend and tuition support) toward graduate study; 30 fellowships awarded annually. No application fee.

item.title: Fondation Vocatio: Bourse Vocatio 2027 (EUR 10,000 for young talents in Belgium)
item.description: Fondation Vocatio · deadline 29 Oct 2026 · EUR 10,000 bourse per laureate, funding a concrete personal project (equipment, production, training). No application fee.

item.title: LA Department of Cultural Affairs: NEAR + CO-UP Artist Residency Grants 2027-28
item.description: City of Los Angeles Department of Cultural Affairs (DCA) · deadline 30 Oct 2026 · NEAR grants of USD 12,000 for individual artists; CO-UP grants of USD 15,000 for collaborations between social-justice nonprofits and artists. No application fee.

item.title: AFTER THE PALACE: Resonance 2026 Video Mapping Contest (Krakow)
item.description: University of the National Education Commission in Krakow (unLoc project) · deadline 30 Oct 2026 · Cash prizes: PLN 10,000 (~EUR 2,340) first place, PLN 6,000 second, PLN 3,000 third; the jury may award additional honorary distinctions or redistribute the pool. Free to enter, submission is exclusively digital.

item.title: Finnish Cultural Foundation: October Round 2026 (all fields of art and science)
item.description: Finnish Cultural Foundation (Suomen Kulttuurirahasto) · deadline 30 Oct 2026 · Around EUR 49 million awarded annually across roughly 2,100 grants; recent October rounds have averaged over 450 working and project grants covering one or more years, with working grants extending up to four years. No application fee.

item.title: 4th Matsu Biennial International Open Call (Matsu Islands, Taiwan)
item.description: Matsu Biennial Promotion Committee (Lienchiang County Government and General Association of Chinese Culture) · deadline 30 Oct 2026 · 4 to 5 proposals are selected; each in principle receives NTD 800,000 (approximately USD 25,000, tax included) in financial support.

item.title: OASis Bom Dia Residency 2027 at Cultivamos Cultura (Sao Luis, Portugal)
item.description: Cultivamos Cultura (European OASis project) · deadline 30 Oct 2026 · EUR 1,300 project fee, travel budget up to EUR 500, production and material expenses up to EUR 1,600 (pre-approved), food per diem, plus free accommodation in a private room in a shared farmhouse and access to a workspace or studio and all Cultivamos Cultura spaces and resources.

item.title: Transatlantic Stars Visual Arts Program 2027: US residencies for EU artists
item.description: European Union Delegation to the United States · deadline 30 Oct 2026 · Fully funded: each selected artist receives a living stipend and a materials budget (amounts not published), plus airfare, visa assistance, on-site lodging, studio space and access to host facilities. Six placements. Free to apply.

item.title: Frame Contemporary Art Finland: Mobility and Production Grants (October 2026 round)
item.description: Frame Contemporary Art Finland · deadline 31 Oct 2026 · Mobility grants EUR 250 to 5,000; production grants EUR 2,500 to 8,000. No application fee.

item.title: Foresight Institute: AI for Science and Safety Nodes RFP 2026 (Local Compute; Coordination and Accountability; AI-first Science)
item.description: Foresight Institute · deadline 31 Oct 2026 · Grants typically USD 30,000 to 100,000 (smaller awards for the Human Empowerment and AI Insurance and Open Governance areas, larger for the rest; bigger amounts possible for the right project), usually paid as one lump sum, with up to 10 percent overhead. Optional office space in San Francisco or Berlin and access to private compute clusters. No application fee.

item.title: KU Leuven AI Safety Lab: Visiting Fellowships 2027 (Leuven)
item.description: KU Leuven AI Safety Lab · deadline 31 Oct 2026 · EUR 2,000 per month for three months, covering accommodation and living costs, plus office space, library access and KU Leuven facilities. Five fellowships. No application fee.

item.title: Schlossmediale Call for Art Residency 2027 (Schloss Werdenberg, Switzerland)
item.description: Schlossmediale Werdenberg · deadline Closed 18 Oct 2026 · CHF 4,000 grant per resident, plus CHF 1,000 for travel, transport and meals, up to CHF 1,000 for material costs, and accommodation in a shared house (individual rooms). Three residencies awarded.

item.title: Tate x Delfina Foundation: Brooks International Fellowship Programme 2027 (London)
item.description: Tate and Delfina Foundation · deadline Closed 21 Oct 2026 · Non-salaried but fully supported: return economy-class flight, UK airport transfers, visa fee reimbursement and visa support via Delfina Foundation, a living allowance bursary of GBP 40 per day, a London Underground and bus travel pass, a single bedroom at Delfina Foundation with shared facilities, and travel to other Tate galleries and UK/European cultural institutions. The Leonora Carrington fellowship adds a research resource allowance. No application fee.

item.title: Creative Industries Fund NL: Residency Videotage 2027 (Hong Kong)
item.description: Creative Industries Fund NL (Stimuleringsfonds Creatieve Industrie), with Videotage · deadline Closed 21 Oct 2026 · One residency grant: EUR 5,000 for a two-month work period or EUR 6,500 for three months, covering travel, insurance, living expenses, compensation for time invested, and material and transport costs. Housing, work space, Videotage guidance and production costs are paid by the Fund directly to Videotage on top of the grant; accommodation is arranged by Videotage. No application fee.

item.title: Screen Australia First Nations Feature Development (up to AUD 45,000)
item.description: Screen Australia · deadline Closed 22 Oct 2026 · Up to AUD 30,000, or up to AUD 45,000 with a producer attached, covering screenplay development including fees for writer, producer, director and story consultant where appropriate.

item.title: Screen Australia First Nations TV Drama Development (up to AUD 65,000)
item.description: Screen Australia · deadline Closed 22 Oct 2026 · Up to AUD 30,000 for one-off projects (AUD 45,000 with a producer attached) and up to AUD 65,000 for series, other than in exceptional circumstances. Provided as a grant.

item.title: Screen Australia First Nations Documentary Development (up to AUD 30,000)
item.description: Screen Australia · deadline Closed 22 Oct 2026 · Up to AUD 30,000 for feature and series documentaries intended for commissioning platforms; up to AUD 20,000 for one-hour television documentaries and for online series. Provided as a grant.

item.title: 2027 ACC NEXT Emerging Asian Artists International Open Call (Gwangju)
item.description: National Asian Culture Center (ACC) · deadline 25 Oct 2026 · Artist fee of KRW 3,000,000 per work, an installation and materials budget of up to KRW 2,000,000 per work, one round-trip international airfare (or domestic transportation), and tentative accommodation at Asia Plex Studio. One artist or team is additionally selected for the 2027 ACC CREATORS Residency through an artist pitch review. For teams, fees, travel and accommodation go to the team leader only.

item.title: The Center Fellowship for Justice-Impacted Artists (Center for Art & Advocacy, US)
item.description: The Center for Art & Advocacy · deadline 25 Oct 2026 · USD 10,000 in unrestricted funds plus USD 10,000 in project development funds per fellow, awarded annually.

item.title: HIAP: Learning Materials International Artist Residency 2027 (Suomenlinna, Helsinki)
item.description: HIAP (Helsinki International Artist Programme), with Kone Foundation · deadline 26 Oct 2026 · Working grant of EUR 1,350 per month (EUR 4,050 total for 90 days) via Kone Foundation, material budget up to EUR 750, access budget up to EUR 1,000, one return trip covered (slow travel encouraged), plus accommodation and workspace. For collectives, the working grant can be paid to one individual only and there is no additional travel budget.

item.title: Invisible Cartographies: Residency for Neurodivergent Artists (Buinho, Portugal)
item.description: Buinho Creative Hub (Creative Europe project Invisible Cartographies) · deadline 26 Oct 2026 · EUR 1,200 artist fee for the six weeks, free accommodation for the full period, travel budget up to EUR 300, plus a production budget and FabLab access. Meals not included. No application fee.

item.title: Culture Push: Black Utopian Fellowship 2027 (New York City)
item.description: Culture Push · deadline Closed 15 Oct 2026 · USD 2,250 stipend, plus fiscal sponsorship for fundraising, mentorship and strategizing support, per the umbrella Fellowship for Utopian Practice guidelines. No application fee.

item.title: Culture Push: Disability Arts + Dreaming Fellowship 2027 (New York City)
item.description: Culture Push · deadline Closed 15 Oct 2026 · USD 2,250 stipend, plus fiscal sponsorship for fundraising, a Thought Partner, mentors in the field, and access check-ins, per the umbrella Fellowship for Utopian Practice guidelines. No application fee.

item.title: Culture Push: Climate Justice Fellowship 2027 (New York City)
item.description: Culture Push · deadline Closed 15 Oct 2026 · USD 2,250 stipend, plus fiscal sponsorship for fundraising, mentorship and strategizing support, per the umbrella Fellowship for Utopian Practice guidelines. No application fee.

item.title: Gulbenkian Institute for Advanced Study Fellowships 2027/28 (Lisbon)
item.description: Gulbenkian Institute for Advanced Study (GIAS), Calouste Gulbenkian Foundation · deadline Closed 15 Oct 2026 · Up to 15 fellowships a year. Each covers travel costs, travel and health insurance, a monthly stipend and a partial housing subsidy; the stipend level is set at selection based on CV and length of stay. No application fee.

item.title: National Parks Arts Foundation: Hawai'i Volcanoes National Park Residency, October 2027 (All Media)
item.description: National Parks Arts Foundation (NPAF) · deadline Closed 20 Oct 2026 · USD 4,000 stipend, plus a month's housing in a three-bedroom house with recording booth, meditation area and art-studio conversion, about 30 minutes from park headquarters. Travel and required insurance are the artist's own responsibility. APPLICATION FEE: USD 60 single artist, USD 120 couple or duo, USD 160 group of 3 or more.

item.title: Transluce: Governance & Policy Fellow (San Francisco)
item.description: Transluce · deadline Closed 20 Oct 2026 · USD 200,000 to 300,000 per year salary plus benefits. Full-time; part-time possible for exceptional candidates.

item.title: Onassis ONX: ONX Seeds 2026, Soft Circuits for Hard Times (Athens, hybrid)
item.description: Onassis ONX (Onassis Foundation) · deadline 26 Oct 2026 · EUR 1,000 to 5,000 seed funding per project, set by scope; up to four projects selected. Plus weekly technical, curatorial and business mentoring, online masterclasses, studio and equipment access at Onassis Ready for Athens-based teams, and presentation at ONX Exhibition Athens (17 to 21 March 2027) with travel, accommodation and artwork transport covered for non-Athens participants. No application fee.

item.title: Propuestas VEGAP 2026: XXX Call for Visual Creation Grants
item.description: VEGAP (Visual Entidad de Gestion de Artistas Plasticos), Fondo Asistencial y Cultural · deadline 26 Oct 2026 · EUR 100,000 total: 20 grants of EUR 5,000 each. No application fee.

item.title: City of Timisoara Project Centre: Mobilities for Cultural Professionals 2026
item.description: Centrul de Proiecte al Municipiului Timisoara · deadline 27 Oct 2026 · Maximum RON 7,500 per national mobility; maximum RON 10,000 per international mobility. Non-reimbursable, with a required co-funding of at least 1% of the project budget. No application fee.

item.title: Burning Man: BRC Honoraria Art Grants 2027 (Letter of Intent)
item.description: Burning Man Project · deadline 29 Oct 2026 · USD 1.5 million annual art-grant budget across approximately 75 projects; grants fund 40 to 60% of the proposed total budget, and the official page notes grants over USD 20,000 are rare. No fixed per-award figure is published. No application fee.

item.title: 2027 LOOP Open Call for Exhibition Proposals (Seoul)
item.description: Alternative Space LOOP · deadline Closed 05 Oct 2026 · Project grant of KRW 1,000,000, plus exhibition space at Alternative Space LOOP, curatorial and operational support, exhibition graphic design and promotion, and use of LOOP's available equipment. 1-2 individuals or teams are selected. No application fee mentioned.

item.title: Ontario Arts Council: Media Artists Creation Projects (October 2026 deadline)
item.description: Ontario Arts Council · deadline Closed 08 Oct 2026 · Emerging: maximum CAD 10,000; Mid-Career and Established: maximum CAD 40,000. No application fee.

item.title: Manitoba Arts Council: Create Grant (October 2026 intake)
item.description: Manitoba Arts Council · deadline Closed 10 Oct 2026 · Emerging: up to CAD 7,500; Mid-career: up to CAD 10,000; Established: up to CAD 15,000. No application fee.

item.title: Eyebeam AGENCY Virtual Residency, Fall 2026 (US-based artists)
item.description: Eyebeam · deadline Closed 11 Oct 2026 · USD 2,000 stipend for each of six selected artists, plus weekly residency programming, mentorship with Eyebeam alumni and visiting professionals, technical consultation, and access to tools and expertise through Eyebeam's network. No application fee (via Submittable).

item.title: Rhizome x Hartwig Art Foundation: Amsterdam City Fellow (two-year digital art research fellowship)
item.description: Rhizome, in partnership with Hartwig Art Foundation · deadline Closed 12 Oct 2026 · EUR 1,200 per month stipend for a part-time commitment of roughly 2 days per week, over a two-year term (about EUR 28,800 total). Tickets to the Extreme Presence gathering provided. No application fee indicated.

item.title: CNC: Fonds d'aide a la creation immersive (October 2026 session)
item.description: CNC (Centre national du cinema et de l'image animee) · deadline Closed 12 Oct 2026 · Selective aid in four strands: ecriture, preproduction, production and portage. The call page publishes percentage caps (up to 50% of French financing, 80% by derogation); CNC's own published commission results show ecriture grants of EUR 10,000 to 12,000, preproduction up to EUR 60,000 and production up to EUR 80,000. No application fee.

item.title: Federation Wallonie-Bruxelles: Bourses et aides aux projets en Arts numeriques (15 October 2026 session)
item.description: Federation Wallonie-Bruxelles, Service de la Creation artistique (Direction des Arts visuels) · deadline Closed 15 Oct 2026 · Bourses (creation or research, individuals only): EUR 1,000 to 15,000. Aides au projet (conception, production, promotion, diffusion): EUR 1,000 to 50,000. No application fee.

item.title: Hessische Kulturstiftung: Reise- und Residenzstipendien 2027/2028 (18th round)
item.description: Hessische Kulturstiftung · deadline Closed 15 Oct 2026 · Travel grants of EUR 25,000 (3 to 12 months), plus access to up to EUR 7,700 additional production funding after the grant. 14 grants over two years: 5 travel, 7 residency (NYC, London, Paris, Istanbul, Kyoto), 2 combined. NOTE: figures are from the call text as republished verbatim by listing sites; the official funding-guidelines PDF was unavailable at the time of adding, so verify on hkst.de. No application fee.

item.title: Arts Convergences Video Prize, 6th edition (short films on mental illness)
item.description: Arts Convergences, in partnership with Thanks for Nothing · deadline Closed 19 Oct 2026 · EUR 5,000 total: Grand Prize EUR 2,000, Jury Prize EUR 1,500, Public Choice Prize EUR 1,500 (online vote). Additional prizes may be awarded. No entry fee.

item.title: La Biennale di Venezia: Biennale College Blend, 2nd edition (EUR 20,000 award)
item.description: La Biennale di Venezia · deadline Closed 19 Oct 2026 · One Biennale College Blend Award of EUR 20,000 to the most compellingly structured project. Accommodation covered for the Venice workshop (travel not covered). No application fee.

item.title: BUBBLE Open Call 2026 at Neue Baeckerei (Wiesbaden)
item.description: Neue Baeckerei, Wiesbaden · deadline Closed 30 Sep 2026 · EUR 300 artist fee per selected artist, plus up to EUR 100 towards shipping and insurance. No application fee.

item.title: SAM Residencies Open Call: Cycle 4 (2027/2028) at Singapore Art Museum
item.description: Singapore Art Museum · deadline Closed 30 Sep 2026 · Monthly stipend of SGD 1,500 plus a shared studio or co-working space for all residents. International residents also receive a return economy flight, housing arrangement and visa assistance; Singapore-based residents receive an additional monthly local allowance of SGD 250. No application fee.

item.title: Gurl Grant: USD 2,500 for female and non-binary short film directors
item.description: Gurl Grant (Kat VanCleave) · deadline Closed 30 Sep 2026 · USD 2,500 cash grant toward the production of a narrative short film, awarded twice yearly. No application fee.

item.title: No Drama 2.0: USD 50,000 horror short film initiative (Monkeypaw x Universal x American Cinematheque)
item.description: Monkeypaw Productions, Universal Pictures and American Cinematheque · deadline Closed 30 Sep 2026 · Up to three filmmakers each receive USD 50,000 to fund production of a short film / proof of concept, plus mentorship from Monkeypaw, Universal and American Cinematheque executives, eligibility to screen at Beyond Fest 2027, and first-look consideration from Universal Pictures and Monkeypaw. No application fee.
